issuers.name: Spanish state route: PECAL, audited through DGAM structures
issuers.notes: The Spanish equivalent of AQAP is PECAL, audited through the structures of the Dirección General de Armamento y Material rather than a commercial certification body. On this route ISO 9001 from an ENAC-accredited body is a formal precondition, not only a practical one (DGAM procedure PA 4302); see the PECAL certification page.

steps.name: AQAP 2110 quality assurance certification
steps.priceNote: In your country the state issues this itself, so the vendor price ranges in our sources do not apply and none is shown.
steps.summary: NATO quality assurance requirements for design, development and production. Not an eligibility condition of EDF, EDIP or SAFE: it enters through individual contracts and cascades down the supply chain.

issuers.name: Dirección General de Armamento y Material (DGAM), Ministerio de Defensa
issuers.notes: Initial audit by the DGAM; renewal and surveillance audits by certification bodies recognised by the CMDIN. The DGAM issues a quote for the fee; no amount is published.

steps.name: PECAL certification (Spain, DGAM)

neededFor.title: PECAL quality requirements come with the contract

steps.note: The chicken-and-egg of PECAL: the DGAM's initial audit expects a PECAL system audited by your management for at least nine months and at least one Ministry of Defence contract with PECAL requirements in the last two years (or a certificate of conformity signed by a DGAM quality representative). A newcomer therefore usually meets PECAL inside a first contract, under the quality representative's oversight, and applies for the certificate afterwards. It is not a block before a first contract: get the RID and ISO 9001 (or EN 9100) first.

prerequisites.name: RID registration (Registro de la Industria de Defensa, Spain)

steps.priceNote: In your country the state issues this itself, so the vendor price ranges in our sources do not apply and none is shown.
steps.summary: The Spanish state certification of a quality management system against PECAL 2110 or 2310 (the Spanish editions of AQAP). It needs the RID and ISO 9001 or EN 9100 first, and the initial audit expects prior PECAL contract experience.
